OFFER TO PURCHASE FOR CASH by Alder Fixed Cash Corp of up to 2,000,000 Shares of its Common Stock at a Purchase Price of $12.50 per Share, net to the seller in cash, without interest. THE OFFER, PRORATION PERIOD AND WITHDRAWAL RIGHTS WILL EXPIRE AT 5:00 P.M., NEW YORK CITY TIME, ON MONDAY, NOVEMBER 30, 2026, UNLESS THE OFFER IS EXTENDED. Odd Lots. Upon the terms and subject to the conditions of the Offer, if more than 2,000,000 Shares are properly tendered, we will purchase all Shares tendered by any Odd Lot Holder who owns beneficially or of record an aggregate of fewer than 100 Shares and who tenders all such Shares. This preference is not available to partial tenders. Odd Lots will not be subject to proration. Conditions of the Offer. The Offer is not conditioned on any minimum number of Shares being tendered.
